title: Errors proved costly as Alas Pilipinas Men swept by South Korea in Asiad opener
summary: Alas Pilipinas Men put up a fight but came up short against South Korea, 16-25, 25-27, 22-25, in their opening match at the 20th Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026, Sunday at the Park Arena Komaki.
